artifactRequest.configuration: Selected scenario: the saved notebook as stored. Source order is zero-based cell-array order 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 3. Recorded order is the ascending order of the cells' last saved non-null execution_count values: cell 0 (1) -> cell 2 (2) -> cell 1 (3) -> cell 3 (4). No live kernel state, command-line arguments, alternate configuration, or execution is assumed. features.npz is referenced relative to the notebook runtime working directory but was not loaded or inspected.
artifactRequest.question: Explain the notebook workflow with exact cell citations, separate source order from recorded execution order, and qualify findings that depend on runtime state.
artifactRequest.scope: Static, native-model interpretation of the single supplied saved notebook; no import, execution, legacy static analyzer, external workspace, or earlier artifact was used.

claims.summary: The artifact correctly lays out cells 0, 1, 2, and 3 in stored source order.
It correctly derives the saved-count order 0, 2, 1, 3 and states that these last-saved counters do not prove a fresh-kernel execution history.
Cell 2 reads X and y while their only visible assignments are in cell 1, creating an unresolved kernel-state dependency under saved-count order.
The notebook calls fit_transform(X) before splitting X_scaled, so scaler fitting includes the eventual test rows in any successful execution of cell 2.
The source omission of zero_grad is directly observable; cross-batch gradient accumulation is a PyTorch semantic inference, and the artifact marks the finding inferred.
It correctly identifies the Linear(10,3) model, CrossEntropyLoss, Adam over model.parameters(), and one loader loop with backward then step.
The artifact notes that X_test and y_test have no later consumer and no evaluation occurs in the notebook.
Runtime shape, dtype, label encoding, and file availability remain unresolved because features.npz was not inspected.
The artifact correctly indicates no metric, evaluation, display, model save, or checkpoint in the inspected notebook.
